
## Install

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yuvraj-cyborg/notopod/main/install.sh | sh
```

The right binary for your machine, checked against its `.sha256` below and
put in `~/.local/bin`. Add `-s -- --to DIR` to choose somewhere else.

Or take an archive from the assets below and put `notopod` on your `PATH`,
or build it: `cargo install --git https://github.com/Yuvraj-cyborg/notopod`.
